fix: Make the abandonment callback a type parameter instead of a boxed trait object: `pub(crate) struct RequestReceiver<T, F: FnOnce() + Send + Sync> { receiver: Option<oneshot::Receiver<T>>, abandoned: Option<F> }`, `new(receiver, abandoned: F)` storing `Some(abandoned)`, and the Drop impl as `impl<T, F: FnOnce() + Send + Sync> Drop for RequestReceiver<T, F>`.
